name: EPIC 220185674
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 12.5 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220185674 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.526289 (16th-84th percentiles 12.24533-12.96744), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220185674 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4752.734375 (16th-84th percentiles 4665.46875-4860.546875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,753 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.81 solar masses and 12.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,599 K at its surface.
